question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**actually**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the give blank is '**actually**'.
 
• It means 'really; in fact'. (वस्‍तुतः; सचमुच)
 
 
• *Example: I can’t believe that I’m **actually** going to America!*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Answer:__** *The train came out of the jungle and passed fields of sugarcane and villages of mud huts. Children **shouted** and waved to the train, though **there** was no one in it except Suraj, the guard and the **engine** driver. Suraj waved back. Usually he **was** in a field, waving; today, he was **actually** on a train. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **frequently**: regularly or habitually; often. (बार-बार)
 
• **absolutely**: completely; totally. (पूरी तरह से; सर्वथा; संपूर्ण रूप से)
 
• **definitely**: certainly; without a doubt. (पक्‍के तौर पर; निस्‍संदेह)
